findings.title: History membership advances past an unfinished occurrence
findings.reproduction: Onboard 200 tracks of180000ms. Play station. Set provider progress177000; force sync; pause. Add provider recent listing of that same track/current station; force sync. Confirm saved progress177000. Normal Play starts next track/index1 at0 instead of same occurrence/index0 at177000. Separate restored null-progress case also skips0→1; a later track3 listing advances0→4 despite unfinished0/42000.
findings.expected: NN-04: resume same unfinished occurrence at latest observed progress, or same occurrence from0 if unavailable. A recent track listing alone is not occurrence completion proof.
findings.actual: resumePastHeard treats track-level played_at membership as completed; a5s cutoff discards valid observed near-end progress and null progress cannot satisfy midSong.
findings.repair: Require reliable occurrence-bound completion/forward observation evidence; preserve current stable occurrence for null/zero/near-end progress and avoid skipping intervening occurrences based only on furthest track ID. Add partial listing, unknown progress, near-end pause and repeated-occurrence regressions.

findings.title: Definitive rejected resume irreversibly overwrites candidate checkpoint
findings.reproduction: Saved station at index0/progress23000; history track3/current context; player switched to unrelated context. Intercept PUT/me/player/play with403 PREMIUM_REQUIRED. play(id,mika-phone) returns premium refusal, but durable candidate changes index0/23000→4/0, pendingnull. Restart retains overwritten checkpoint.
findings.expected: Definitive refusal/preflight failure leaves existing candidate occurrence and progress intact; requested/accepted/observed stay distinct.
findings.actual: resumePastHeard saves new index/progress/observedAt before device selection/provider acceptance; existing catch only clears pending/status and cannot restore previous checkpoint.
findings.repair: Keep proposed start position separate from authoritative saved checkpoint; commit only after valid acceptance/observation, preserve prior fields after no-device/restricted/premium/quota/auth refusals; extend refused-start tests with history-backed advance.

findings.title: Ten-minute track-only dedup drops distinct repeated listening history
findings.reproduction: Record one completed seen play with actual cached metadata via recordSeenPlay. Advance clock4min. Provider recently-played returns same track with new playedAt and DIFFERENT contextUri; full sync. plays count remains1 instead of2.
findings.expected: NN-02/NN-08: preserve distinct real listening occurrences, including repeated tracks/private→normal/context switches; delayed listing of same occurrence deduplicates once.
findings.actual: seen_plays expanded to10min matches only trackid/time, not context or occurrence; new real listing is discarded and history/memory round accounting is lost.
findings.repair: Bind delayed-listing dedup to supported occurrence evidence and context; do not suppress distinct later starts/listings solely because trackid matches within10min. Add private observation→distinct repeat under10min, different context, same context with distinct start and delayed same-occurrence tests.
